name: Jake LaTurner
bio: a Representative from Kansas; born in Galena, Cherokee County, Kans., February 17, 1988; graduated from Galena High School, Galena, Kans.; B.A., Pittsburg State University, Pittsburg, Kans.; customer service representative; staff, United States Representative Lynn Jenkins, 2009-2012; member of the Kansas state senate, 2013-2017; Kansas state treasurer, 2017-2020; elected as a Republican to the One Hundred Seventeenth and to the succeeding Congress (January 3, 2021-January 3, 2025); was not a candidate for reelection to the One Hundred Nineteenth Congress in 2024.
